calls.title: Add project opens from the composer, not the spine
calls.chose: ctrl+o, a plus beside PROJECT, and a first row in its list
calls.because: The composer is TD's New thread; the spine's PROJECTS face already calls a group of tabs a project.
passed_over: A second button beside + NEW in the inbox spine
calls.undo: Move the button; the dialog does not care where it opens from.

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture

calls.title: Picking a new SSH host adds it to machines.toml
calls.chose: Append it to machines.toml after one ssh check succeeds
calls.because: Their fork keeps the machine it connects; a host forgotten when the dialog closes would have to be picked again every time.
passed_over: Use the host for this one dialog only
calls.undo: Delete the two lines it appended.

calls.title: Git hosts are left out of the machine list
calls.chose: Skip hosts on a known forge or with User git, and count them
calls.because: github-bfs and friends are git remotes in ~/.ssh/config, not machines an agent can run on.

calls.title: A new host's key is never accepted for the person
calls.chose: BatchMode only; an untrusted key asks them to run ssh once
calls.because: Accepting a host key unseen is the one step ssh exists to make a person look at.
calls.undo: Add StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new to the dialog's ssh options.

calls.title: Added folders are remembered in a new projects.toml
calls.chose: projects.toml beside machines.toml, only for folders the scan cannot see
calls.because: The PROJECT list is a depth-one scan of five roots; it cannot see a deeper folder or another machine.
passed_over: A list inside the session file
calls.undo: Delete projects.toml; the scan is unchanged.

calls.title: Clone and start new land in the folder being shown
calls.chose: Under the folder step's folder, ~/Work at first; owner/repo means GitHub
calls.because: One place to choose where things go, and ~/Work is the scan's first root.
calls.undo: Change the default folder or drop the shorthand.

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture

verdict.note: Parker chose 'The folder being shown' when asked, 2026-11-08.

calls.title: A far project keeps its machine
calls.chose: Choosing it sets MACHINE; sending it on another machine is refused
calls.because: A folder on farbox does not exist here, and an agent started in a missing folder is a confusing failure.

calls.title: A git URL in the sentence is offered for cloning
calls.chose: The clone field starts with the first git URL in the sentence
calls.because: Parker's screenshot: the repository was in the sentence and no project could hold it.
